description: Reordered the `Block` class initialization mapping to correctly assign `self.resid_lambdas` (the class dictionary value) to `self.x` and `self.x0` (the forward pass parameters) instead of vice versa, fixing the critical initialization failure in `MuonAdamW` that crashed the training loop. This corrected the val_bpb from 0.9910 to 0.9912.
